data:text/html,<body><h1>Pong</h1><div class="container"><div class="left-paddle item"></div><div class="right-paddle item"></div><div class="ball item"></div></div><style>.container{position:relative;background:black;color:white;font-family:sans-serif;width:800px;height:500px}.item{position:absolute;background-color:white}.left-paddle{width:10px;height:80px;left:20px}.right-paddle{width:10px;height:80px;right:20px}.ball{width:10px;height:10px}</style><script>let e=210,t=210,r=245,n=395,o=2,a=2;const l=document.querySelector(".left-paddle"),s=document.querySelector(".right-paddle"),d=document.querySelector(".ball");document.addEventListener("keydown",r=>{"w"===r.key&&(e-=10),"s"===r.key&&(e+=10),"ArrowUp"===r.key&&(t-=10),"ArrowDown"===r.key&&(t+=10)}),function y(){n+=o,r+=a,(r<0||r>490)&&(a*=-1),(n<0||n>790)&&(r=245,n=395),n+10>20&&n<30&&r+10>e&&r<e+80&&(o*=-1),n+10>770&&n<780&&r+10>t&&r<t+80&&(o*=-1),l.style.transform=`translateY(${e}px)`,s.style.transform=`translateY(${t}px)`,d.style.transform=`translate(${n}px, ${r}px)`,requestAnimationFrame(y)}();</script></body>
